subject: general
question: Where was the Khelo India Youth Games 2024 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games 2024 were hosted in **Tamil Nadu**, showcasing the state's commitment to promoting sports at the grassroots level.
 
• This multi-disciplinary sporting event aims to identify and nurture young talent across India by providing a competitive platform.
 
• Over 4,000 athletes from various states and union territories participated in the event, competing across multiple disciplines.
 
• The initiative aligns with the central government’s broader vision under the **Khelo India programme**, which aims to revive the sports culture in India.
 
• State-of-the-art infrastructure and logistics were arranged to ensure a world-class experience for participants and spectators alike.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Programme**

 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in 2018, the programme aims to strengthen India’s sports ecosystem.
 
• It focuses on **talent identification, infrastructure development, and player support** through scholarships and training.
 
• The programme is designed to engage youth in sports to promote fitness and well-being while creating a pool of elite athletes for international events.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Youth Games**
 
 
• Youth Games act as a foundational platform for young athletes to showcase their talent and gain exposure.
 
• These events help in the identification of future sports stars who could represent India in global competitions like the Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Past Host States**
 
 
• The inaugural Khelo India Youth Games (2018) were held in Delhi.
 
• Subsequent editions were hosted by states like Maharashtra (2019), Assam (2020), and Madhya Pradesh (2023).
 
 
 
• **Role of Tamil Nadu in Sports**
 
 
• Tamil Nadu has a rich sports culture, with achievements in chess, squash, cricket, and athletics.
 
• The state government has invested significantly in sports infrastructure and training facilities to nurture talent.
